headline: Not Wanting Indonesia's Capital Market to Be Abandoned by Investors, OJK Prepares 4 Measures
summary: Indonesia's financial services regulator OJK is focusing on restoring global investor trust in the capital market through transparency, supervision and law enforcement. Four measures are being prepared.
why: The Financial Services Authority (OJK) regulates Indonesia's capital markets, and investor confidence affects foreign flows into Indonesian stocks and bonds.
original_headline: Tak Mau Pasar Modal RI Ditinggal Investor, OJK Siapkan 4 Jurus Ini
